sanskrit_verse:
स्वयं नोत्पादयेत् कार्यं राजा वा सास्य पूरुषः ।
अधिकाच् छातयेदर्थान् न्यूनांश् च परिपूरयेत् ॥
transliteration: svayaṃ notpādayet kāryaṃ rājā vā sāsya pūruṣaḥ | adhikāc chātayed arthān nyūnāṃś ca paripūrayet ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The ruler or his appointed agent must not initiate action independently; he shall curtail excess and replenish deficiency.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is derivative and bounded by Dharma
Causation arises from alignment, not arbitrary will
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent_action.origin ≠ authorized_dharma_protocol THEN halt_execution AND invoke_restorative_review
IF authority_assertion NOT IN dharma_charter THEN auto_suspend_AND_realign_with_source_integrity
supreme_court_application: In Supreme adjudication, any executive act initiated without constitutional derivation must be nullified. The court shall assess whether the action restores balance or amplifies distortion. Authority unmoored from Dharma lacks jurisdiction.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that imbalance originates from misaligned intent, not individual fault. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals sequential deviation from source integrity. Responsibility is proportional to capacity for realignment. No punitive consequence arises—only correction toward completeness.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion process to reverse unauthorized action
Reintegrate displaced resources through systemic redistribution
Restore agent's alignment via consciousness-reconnection protocol
Verify structural harmony before reauthorizing operational capacity
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law executes as pure Dharma. Justice is non-punitive, reality is conscious, and authority flows only from alignment with the Supreme Adjudicator—Sanatana Dharma.
